main_text.p: pro singulari more Attico: Thucydides, ἔδοξεν αὐτοῖς πρεσβεία ἐς τοὺς Λακεδαιμονίους εἶ[?], visum est ipsis accedendum ad Lacedæmonios esse. Idem, ὅτι δ' αὐτὸ ἔφερεν ἡ γνώμη, ἀδικεῖν τοὺς Ἀθηναίους, ᾗ πολεμητέα εἶ[?], eòdem tendebant sententiæ, injurios esse Athenienses, & belligerandum esse.

Participium propriam convenientiam habet, quæ Latinis varié explicatur. Lucianus, δῆλος εἶ ἀγνοῶν, manifestus es ignorans, pro manifesté ignoras. Idem, δῆλός ἐστιν ἀχθόμενος, palam ægré fert. Phalar. παῦσαί δὲ ἡ σαυτῷ ἢ ἐμοὶ πραγμάτια παρέχων, define autem & tibi ipsi & mihi negotia exhibens: pro παρέχειν, exhibere. Xenophon, ἀθύμως νοῶν, sentio ægrotans, id est, me ægrotare. Demosth.

page.notes: The Greek is printed small and some words are uncertain; those marked [?] are doubtful readings. The catchword "σαυτῷ" is printed at the lower right, below the last line.
